title: AARP — claimed by thegentlemen
description: US · Healthcare · aarp.org Revenue $10 Billion AARP Founded in 1958 by a retired teacher who found a former colleague living in a chicken coop, AARP now serves 38 million Americans over 50 from Washington, built on the idea of serving rather than being served.It is also the country's largest publisher, with a 22-million-copy magazine, a news bulletin, podcasts, film awards, games and about 25 million people a month
